To differentiate itself, it will deepen its 6MD product policy and focus on detailed product assortment, proposal-based product development and developing new procurement routes. For new store openings, its main format combines fresh food with clothing, with priority given to Sapporo and its surrounding area, central and eastern Hokkaido, and it also plans to roll out small-catchment food stores for smaller towns and villages.
